title: Best Phone Deals (Black Friday 2026)
summary: 5 phones worth buying in the Black Friday sale, why each one is worth it, and the October 2026 prices to beat.
intro: 🔥 {deal_hook} on top phones, but only while the offer lasts.
We picked 5 phones for different budgets, from a flagship Galaxy to a $399 everyday phone. Prices can jump back or sell out at any time, so grab yours before it is gone.
method: Picks come from Memeburn's Black Friday phone deals roundup (published Oct 11 and updated Oct 13, 2026) and Tom's Guide's Prime Day phone deals list (Oct 7, 2026). Prices are the deal prices those outlets reported at the retailer named, compared with the brand's list price. They change often, so treat each as a price to beat, not a promise. The Amazon buttons search for the model, so check storage size and color before you buy.
assumptions: no price is guaranteed on Black Friday itself. Samsung raised Galaxy S26 list prices in early October, so a discount now buys less than it looks. We will update this guide when real Black Friday deals go live.

products.name: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra
why: The Galaxy S26 Ultra is Samsung's most capable phone, and it is $420 below list price in this deal. Its new Privacy Display stops people next to you from reading your screen, and you can set it to turn on in apps like banking.

Charging is faster than before, at 60W wired and 25W wireless, and the camera system has a 200MP main camera plus 5x zoom. Memeburn also points out that Samsung raised the list price by $100, so this $979 deal is roughly the same real discount as last year's S25 Ultra at just under $900.
specs: 6.9-inch Dynamic AMOLED 2X display, 120Hz, with Privacy Display
cons: Battery is 5,000mAh, smaller than many rivals
No built-in magnets, so snap-on chargers need a magnetic case
products.best_for: Power users who want the best Android phone and a long update promise.
products.skip_if: you want a small phone, or you do not need flagship cameras and a big screen.
products.deal_note: Memeburn says this price already matches last year's Black Friday depth after Samsung's price rise, so waiting may not save more.
products.amazon_listing: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra, Unlocked Android Smartphone, 256GB, Black | Privacy Display, Gal

products.name: Google Pixel 11
why: The Pixel 11 is built around Google's camera processing and AI features. A 5x zoom camera is unusual at this price, and Memeburn says battery life is much better: its video playback test lasted 25 hours and 25 minutes, about three hours more than the Pixel 10.

It also gets seven years of updates, through 2033. The trade-off is speed, since the Galaxy S26 scored 64% higher in multi-core benchmarks. For messaging, photos and streaming that gap rarely shows, but it matters for 4K video editing or demanding games.
specs: 4,985mAh battery, 30W wired and 25W Qi2.2 wireless charging
pros: Excellent display and cameras for the price
cons: Slower than Samsung and Apple rivals in heavy tasks
Wired charging takes about 1 hour 15 minutes
products.best_for: People who care most about photos, clean software and long support.
products.skip_if: you play demanding games or edit 4K video on your phone.
products.deal_note: Memeburn notes last year's Pixel 10 dropped $200 before Black Friday, while the Pixel 11 is $150 off now. A bigger cut could still come.
products.amazon_listing: Google Pixel 11 - Unlocked Smartphone, Gemini - 256 GB - Obsidian | Android, Gemini Intell

products.name: Apple iPhone Air
why: Apple rarely discounts new iPhones, and the iPhone Air is one of the few getting a real retail cut, at $260 off. At $839, Memeburn says it costs less than the standard iPhone 17.

It is Apple's thinnest phone, at 5.64mm and 165g, and it runs the same class of chip as last year's Pro models. The price you pay for that design is a single rear camera, a smaller battery than other current iPhones and eSIM only.
specs: eSIM only, no physical SIM slot
pros: One of the few iPhones with a real retail discount
cons: Only one rear camera, no ultrawide or optical zoom lens
Smaller battery than other current iPhones
products.best_for: iPhone fans who want a light, big-screen phone without paying Pro prices.
products.skip_if: you want a zoom lens or the longest possible battery life.
products.deal_note: This price was reported at Best Buy, not Amazon. Memeburn says carrier trade-in deals on the iPhone 18 Pro can be bigger, but they lock you in for up to 36 months.

products.name: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE
why: The S26 FE brings the main parts of the Galaxy S experience, including a telephoto camera, fast charging and wireless charging, at a lower price. It was also the only S26 model Samsung did not raise in October.
At $574 it is $125 below list. Its 45W charging reaches about 69% in 30 minutes. The price is for the 128GB model, so check the storage on the listing.
pros: Large display and telephoto camera at a mid-range price
Price was not raised in October
cons: Exynos chip is a step below the Snapdragon in the S26 and S26 Ultra
products.best_for: People who want most of a Galaxy flagship for under $600.
products.skip_if: you want the fastest chip, or you need more than 128GB of storage.
products.deal_note: Memeburn says last year's S25 FE fell under $443 on Black Friday, though it also launched at a lower price.
products.amazon_listing: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE, Unlocked Phone, Pistachio, 256GB | Galaxy AI, AI Photo Editor, 50MP

products.name: Samsung Galaxy A57
why: The Galaxy A57 is thin, light and easy to use. Its screen gets as bright as 1,900 nits, so it is readable outdoors, and Memeburn says the battery lasts about a day and a half in typical use.
At $399 it is $150 below Samsung's starting price. It has IP68 water resistance and six major Android updates, which is a lot for the price. Photos can look flat and it is not built for heavy gaming.
pros: Around a day and a half of battery
cons: Photos can look flat with limited dynamic range
products.best_for: Everyday use, with a bright screen, good battery and long updates on a budget.
products.skip_if: you want top camera quality or play demanding games.
products.deal_note: Memeburn lists the A57's list price as $549 to $609 depending on the version, so check which version is on sale.

tips.title: How to spot a real phone deal
items: Compare with the brand's own list price,
not the retailer's crossed-out price. Some stores still show pre-increase prices as the original.
Look at the final price, not just the dollars off.
Samsung raised Galaxy S26 prices by $100 or more in early October, so a big discount now can be the same real price as last year.
Be careful with free phones from carriers.
Carrier deals usually need a trade-in and a pricier plan, and the savings come as monthly credits over up to 36 months. If you leave early, you owe the balance.
Check the model year and storage.
Names can look almost identical across years, and the sale price is often for the smallest storage size.
and whether the phone is the US unlocked version before you buy.

faq: Black Friday is Friday, November 27, 2026, and Cyber Monday is Monday, November 30.
Should I buy now or wait for Black Friday?

Memeburn found that some phone prices in October's Prime sale already matched last year's Black Friday depth, for example the Galaxy S26 Ultra at $979. It also says foldables are where waiting looks smartest. If a phone you want is at a price you like, buying now is reasonable.
Is it better to buy unlocked or from a carrier?
Unlocked phones cost more upfront but let you switch carriers any time. Carrier deals look bigger but usually need a trade-in, a higher-priced plan and up to 36 months of bill credits.
Is the Amazon price the same as Best Buy?
Not always. The iPhone Air deal here was reported at Best Buy. Use the Amazon button to compare the current price, storage size and color.
